name: mRNA-1018-H5
sort_evidence: mRNA-1018-H5 is an H5 pandemic influenza vaccine, a different antigen from the marketed mRNA seasonal flu vaccine, in a CEPI-funded Phase 3 of 4,050 adults (NCT07496450, active not recruiting) (https://cepi.net/cepi-fund-pivotal-phase-3-trial-modernas-mrna-pandemic-influenza-candidate).

trials.title: A Study of mRNA-1018-H5 Pandemic Influenza Vaccine in Healthy Adults
